title: Jab kargaye duniya se safar aon o mohd
body:
JAB KAR GAYE DUNIYA SE SAFAR AON-O-MOHAMMED
THE TASHNA DAHAN TASHNA JIGAR AON-O-MOHAMMED
Mamoo pa fida hogaye sar apna kata kar
Maqtal se chale Shaah jo laasho ko utha kar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayi jo khabar Qaime mein barpa huwa mehshar
Maare gaye Zainab ke pisar Aon-o-Mohammed
Thi dasht-e-museebat mein ghata zulm ki chaye
Wo pyas ki shiddat wo hazaron se ladaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha hukm jo madar ka to dekhi na taraye
Bandhe rahe marne pa kamarAon-o-Mohammed
Masoom the wo teen shab-o-roz ke pyase
Hyder ki shujaat ke sab asaar ayan the
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal mein udhar lagte the anbaar saron ke
Rukh karte the maidaa’n mein jidhar Aon-o-Mohammed
Wada jo tha maadar se usi ko tha nibhaya
Bhoole se suwe naher kabhi mudke na dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha pyaas ki aankhon se rawan ashkon ka dariya
Jab hoke gire khoon mein tar Aon-o-Mohammed
Tar khoon mein betaun ke jo lashe nazar aaye
Dil maa ka tha aakhir wo na kyun gham se bhar aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti thi jo poochenge tumhe apne paraye
Kya unse kahun jaake mai ghar Aon-o-Mohammed
Taqdeer ne beton ki juhin lash dikhaye
Zainab ne jabeen shukar ke sajde mein jhukaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo sabr ka alam tha ke hairaan thi khudaye Phir jate the ankhon mein magar Aon-o-Mohammed
Jis waqt Sohail Ahle Haram qaid se choote
Barpa thi qayamat wo Madine mein jab aaye
Zainab ki zubaa’n par the shab-o-roz ye nale
<<DIVIDER>>
Abaad kabhi hoga na ghar Aon-o-Mohammed
